definitions.explanation: A deep blue color produced from the indigo plant. One of the traditional Japanese colors with deep cultural significance.

examples.japanese: {藍色|あいいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
⟦{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{藍色|あいいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まった→染まる：04254_somaru⟧。
examples.english: The evening sky was dyed indigo.

examples.japanese: {藍色|あいいろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧で、「ジャパン⟦ブルー→ブルー：11276_buruu⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: Indigo is a traditional Japanese color, also called 'Japan Blue.'

notes:
USAGE:
{藍色|あいいろ} refers to the deep blue derived from the indigo plant (⟦{藍|あい}→藍：20100_ai⟧). It is one of Japan's most iconic traditional colors and has been used in textiles for centuries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {藍色|あいいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}める→染める：04253_someru⟧ (to dye indigo)
- {藍色|あいいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧ (indigo cloth)
- ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{藍色|あいいろ} (deep indigo)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Indigo dyeing (⟦{藍染|あいぞ}め→藍染め：23047_aizome⟧) has a long history in Japan. The color was so prevalent in traditional Japanese clothing that foreign visitors called it "Japan Blue." {徳島県|とくしまけん} is particularly famous for indigo production.
